data.long_meaning: Joelleah is derived from the Hebrew name Yoel (or Joel) and the Hebrew word 'Elah', which means 'God'. The name can be interpreted as 'God is my God'. In the Book of Judges, Joel was a prophet who called the people of Israel to repentance and returned them to God. The name Joelleah carries the meaning “God is my God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. in_greek.name: Γιοελέα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιοελέα προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές ρίζες 'אלוהים' και 'ישועה', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου'. Το όνομα αντικατοπτρίζει τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού, με έμφαση στη σωτηρία του Θεού και την παρέμβασή του στη ζωή του ανθρώπου. The name Jolenta was popular among the nobility and clergy, and was often bestowed upon girls who were to be educated for religious life. The name Joelleah became popular during this time period, as a Latinized version of Jolenta.
